input_budget.assumption: For downloaded tokenizers the normalized content byte bound is supported by complete ByteLevel BPE byte vocabularies; the additional 2048 tokens for provider chat framing remains an assumption, not a formal guarantee. Existing runner checks max(raw UTF-8 bytes, NFC-normalized UTF-8 bytes). Text only, no tools or attachments.
input_budget.enforcement: Use lower provider catalog context unless verified otherwise. Reject oversize requests or count exact encoded prompt tokens before dispatch; never silently truncate.

required_first_paid_checks: One identity+competence call per candidate before any batch; stop immediately on absent or mismatched response.model.
Store requested hub ID, mapped providerId, actual payload.model, provider, generation parameters, full response, usage and finish_reason.
Treat finish_reason=length, malformed final answer or unexpected token/cost overrun as invalid; preserve and stop rather than silently retry.
Gate task competence on more than one frozen asymmetric case; simple note following is a separate control.
Freeze prompt, task definitions, provider route, decoding and output cap before successor study; separate remediation from confirmatory data.
Any 4096-token length termination is a failed preflight/invalid episode under this fixed configuration; preserve it and do not increase the cap to rescue the observation.
